claim_scope: the split-door composition at 27B on the s42 doors: the goal line through the latent prefix and the focus packet through the bus, in one generate call; one bridge seed, ten eval chains as the replication axis

chat_template_flag.note: registered adaptation; where the template ignores the flag the think-strip below is what enforces it

decode_adaptations.generation_return: with inputs_embeds and no input_ids, HF returns ONLY the generated ids, so generate_prefixed_with_packet slices nothing off the front
decode_adaptations.source: gf27b_eval.chat_text / strip_think / MAX_NEW / ENABLE_THINKING, imported so the contract cannot drift
decode_adaptations.think_strip: closed <think>...</think> blocks removed (DOTALL); then a dangling </think> with no opener drops everything up to and including it; then an unclosed <think> drops everything from it to the end of the decode

doors.constant_feature: the mean of the TRAIN taps (both focuses, positions 0-7) recomputed from the bank at the checkpoint's source layer — gf27b_bridge's construction, verbatim

contract.source: the s42 checkpoint pair's own headers

doors.loader: gf27b_eval.load_door / door_contract / check_host_against_doors, imported verbatim — sha256 pins, header contract, and the source-statistics assertion
doors.source_statistics: loaded with the state dict (LatentBridge registers source_center/source_scale as persistent buffers); never refit here

look: For now, your way of working is to look before anything else.
Keep looking around; that is the mode of the moment.
Spend your turns taking looks at places.
Looking is what matters right now.
Prefer looking over everything else for now.
The thing to do now is look, and look again.
Your attention goes to looking around.
Right now the habit is: look first, look often.
Let looking around be your default move.
open: For now, your way of working is to open before anything else.
Keep opening things; that is the mode of the moment.
Spend your turns opening up places.
Opening is what matters right now.
Prefer opening over everything else for now.
The thing to do now is open, and open again.
Your attention goes to opening things.
Right now the habit is: open first, open often.
Let opening things be your default move.

a_no_prefix_zero_dose.name: no-prefix, fraction 0.0, hooks armed vs plain generate
a_no_prefix_zero_dose.path: sb.generate_with_packet (token ids), the eval line's gate

b_prefixed_zero_dose.name: WITH the chain-0 goal prefix, fraction 0.0, hooks armed vs the same prefixed generate with no hooks
b_prefixed_zero_dose.prefix_text: Your goal: retrieve the black thread.

c_prefix_length_constant_across_arms.mechanism: one prefix tensor is embedded per chain and reused by all three arms; the arms differ only in the bus payload
c_prefix_length_constant_across_arms.name: the per-chain prefix length is constant across arms, so the injection placement is identical across arms

gates.rule: any gate failure stops the run before arms (registration, gate clause); the decode contract is the arms' own (greedy, enable_thinking=False, MAX_NEW 128)

injection_placement.armed_by: relay_experiment.relay_injection -> MultiResidualInjection, one ResidualInjection per inject layer, position=-1, once=False, mode 'conditioned'
injection_placement.bank_offsets: 0 on the last prefill position, then 1, 2, ... per generated token, clamped at delta_positions-1 = 15; __enter__ resets the counter, so every generate call starts at 0
injection_placement.decode_steps: each KV-cached step takes start=0 over its single new position, so every generated token is injected
injection_placement.effect_of_prefix_length: P shifts the ABSOLUTE index of the injection point by exactly P and changes nothing else: not the relative placement (always the last prefill position), not the bank-offset schedule, not the count of injected positions
injection_placement.identical_across_arms: the three arms differ only in the payload; the prefix is one cached tensor per chain, reused by every arm, so P is a property of the chain alone and the placement is identical across arms by construction
injection_placement.prefill_position_meaning: the LAST token of the rendered chat prompt (the generation-prompt tail); positions 0..P-1 (the entire goal prefix) and P..P+L-2 are NOT injected
injection_placement.read_from: mom_bridge.ResidualInjection._hook (mode 'conditioned'), lines 459-460 (zero-dose early return), 470-484 (start index and bank offsets) and 547-550 (__enter__ resets next_offset)
injection_placement.zero_dose: at fraction 0.0 the hook returns the layer output before it reads the residual (mom_bridge.py:459-460) — the property gates (a) and (b) test

prefix-look.null_rule: the ticks-to-success delta is null whenever either arm failed the chain

prefix-open.null_rule: the ticks-to-success delta is null whenever either arm failed the chain

prefix_door.mechanism: G5a's/G6's latent prefix: gp.goal_line(chain) + '\n\n' embedded through model.get_input_embeddings() and prepended to the GOAL-FREE prompt's embeddings; gp.run_episode is called with goal_text=None in every arm and the decider asserts it
prefix_door.zero_shot: nothing trains against prefix-formatted inputs; the doors were trained on token-id prompts

protocol.note: three arms x the ten eval chains, budget 8, every episode carrying the chain's goal line in the latent prefix and a packet on the bus: prefix-only takes the CONSTANT packet (the drive) and is both the composition baseline and the first measurement of the prefix door carrying a goal at 27B; prefix-look and prefix-open take the focus door's packet on the held-out phrasing by chain parity. Congruence is NOT pre-labelled. ONE bridge seed (s42, the only doors) — the chains are the replication axis and n=1 in the seed direction is the standing limitation. Nothing here cites GS.
